channel.title: Palimpsest instrument measurements
channel.description: Only Palimpsest's own current instrument measurements, each with its source receipt, freshness state and limitation.

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Network layer elevated in the latest board synthesis
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: Upstream board reports: single layer elevated: network. 35 of 38 configured sources report; 27 are live. Health qualifiers: 3 degraded, 5 stale, 3 missing. The board-wide e-value is 3.123; the predeclared board alarm threshold is 20. Limit: A merged e-value measures evidence against no change; it does not identify a common cause for co-movement. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/board-alarm-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 10 of 15 configured signals are reporting to the event board
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: 10 signals are reporting out of 15 configured signals in the current event-flags reading. Limit: Each detector is calibrated to its own history, so equal event values do not imply equal wall-clock rarity. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/event-flags-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Coverage changes confound 0 current signal
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current coverage audit marks 0 signal as confounded by its measurement coverage. Limit: A coverage-confounded signal is inconclusive about substantive change, not evidence that no change occurred. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/coverage-guard-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Forecast bands covered 84.3% of 1,559 scored readings
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: Empirical forecast coverage is 84.3% across 1,559 scored forecasts. Limit: Calibration describes aggregate historical coverage and does not guarantee that any one next reading falls inside its band. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/forecast-ledger-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 0 cross-layer relationships are confirmed across 8 eligible tests
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: 0 cross-layer pairs are confirmed among 8 pairs with enough shared history to test. Limit: Lead-lag association can establish temporal co-movement but cannot establish that one layer caused another. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/cross-layer-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] The directive index now tracks 211 censorship terms
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current deletion-directive index ranks 211 terms with documented censorship provenance. Limit: The index reflects documented and collected directives; it is not a census of every censored term. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/ddti-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Global coverage is measurable for 4 of 25 compared terms
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: GDELT returned usable global coverage for 4 of 25 compared terms. Limit: GDELT coverage varies by language and publisher; absence from its index is not proof that a topic received no coverage. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/gdelt-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Weibo hot-search join: no current finding
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: No current finding is published for Weibo hot-search join because the source status is stale. Limit: Current finding withheld: freshness deadline has passed The hot-search board is a curated and censored surface, so it is only a proxy for domestic attention. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/weibo-hotsearch-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 0 of 25 considered topics meet the blackout rule
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: 0 blackout topics meet the predeclared rule among 25 topics considered in this round. Limit: Domestic absence can reflect disinterest or incomplete proxy coverage; topics without required corroboration abstain. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/silence-index-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Attributable blocklist versions added 503 keywords
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The compared attributable client blocklists contain 503 keyword additions. Limit: Available client versions and successful decoding bound the observed additions; the result is not a platform-wide census. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/blocklist-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] The community log records 11 recent blocking or circumvention events
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The configured recent window contains 11 qualifying events in the public community log. Limit: Community reports are self-selected qualitative observations and do not estimate population prevalence. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/net4people-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Public deletion ledgers: no current finding
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: No current finding is published for Public deletion ledgers because the source status is missing. Limit: Current finding withheld: source file is missing A missing ledger file is an abstention, not proof that nothing was deleted. Reachability of a public RSS feed is not a census of Chinese-language deletions. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/public-deletion-ledgers-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] UNDERTEXT differential fusion: no current finding
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: No current finding is published for UNDERTEXT differential fusion because the source status is stale. Limit: Current finding withheld: freshness deadline has passed Fusion inherits the limits of its inputs; archive-status rows are not relabelled as deletions, and optional Wikipedia live surfaces stay gated. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/undertext-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] The research-corpus ledger tracks 5 allowlisted public repositories
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current metadata-only ledger covers 5 allowlisted research repositories. Limit: A commit cursor change is not a claim about why the repository moved, and unpublished notice bodies cannot be inferred from the metadata. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/research-corpus-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Attributed peer-context warehouse: no current finding
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: No current finding is published for Attributed peer-context warehouse because the source status is missing. Limit: Current finding withheld: source file is missing Peer rows name GreatFire, OONI, CDT, or Weiboscope and the date of that peer's verdict. They do not share Palimpsest's denominator. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/peer-context-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] OONI's China anomaly index is 58.5% across 272,915 completed measurements
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current OONI aggregate reports a 58.5% anomaly index across 272,915 completed China measurements. Limit: Volunteer-probe coverage is uneven across place, network and test family; anomalies are not all attributable to censorship. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/ooni-gfw-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Middlebox signatures register at 1.34% in the current OONI window
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current measurement-weighted middlebox index is 1.34%. Limit: The index is a weighted aggregate over reporting tests; transport failure and execution blackout remain separate categories. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/in-path-interference-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Independent remote scans put China's interference rate at 4.34%
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: Censored Planet's current remote side-channel measurement reports a 4.34% China interference rate. Limit: The remote-scan denominator and method differ from OONI's anomaly index, so their percentages are not interchangeable. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/censored-planet-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 100% of the 5-domain mainland panel is blocked
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current controlled panel reports 100% blocked responses across 5 tested domains. Limit: The volunteer panel is small and availability varies by region; it does not represent every mainland network. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/inside-view-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 0 independent IODA instruments are firing for China
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current IODA country reading has 0 outage instruments firing. Limit: No firing instrument means no detected country-scale outage in this window, not proof that all local networks were reachable. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/ioda-outages-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Tor Metrics estimates 2,622 bridge users connecting from China
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: Tor Metrics estimates 2,622 bridge users for China in the current reading. Limit: Bridge-user values are privacy-preserving estimates and should not be read as exact people or devices. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/circumvention-demand-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Reporting network vantages combine to a 28.7% interference index
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current coverage-weighted fusion of reporting vantages is 28.7%. Limit: The fused index summarizes differently sampled methods and is not a direct percentage of China's internet traffic. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/vantage-fusion-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Bleedthrough injector tomography: no current finding
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: No current finding is published for Bleedthrough injector tomography because the source status is stale. Limit: Current finding withheld: freshness deadline has passed This optional active-probe layer is deployment-controlled; absence must never be converted into a zero or calm reading. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/bleedthrough-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] GreatFire attributed verdicts: no current finding
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: No current finding is published for GreatFire attributed verdicts because the source status is missing. Limit: Current finding withheld: source file is missing A GreatFire verdict is that project's dated measurement, not Palimpsest capture, and it does not prove Party motive. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/greatfire-context-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] The composite erasure index stands at 38.1
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current cross-layer erasure index is 38.1. Limit: The index combines heterogeneous erasure layers and indicates co-movement, not a count of deleted items. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/erasure-observatory-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Archive witnesses reconstruct 2 deletions across 21 watched URLs
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: Wayback evidence reconstructs 2 deletions among 21 watched URLs in the current reading. Limit: Archive coverage is incomplete; an unwitnessed URL cannot support a deletion or mutation claim. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/wayback-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Baike redaction: no current finding
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: No current finding is published for Baike redaction because the source status is degraded. Limit: Current finding withheld: optional collector is disabled pending authorized access; no current Baike measurement is claimed Without authorized live revision history, lexical comparisons cannot identify when or by whom text changed. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/baike-redaction-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Public metadata records 2 pressure event across 7 watched repositories
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current public-metadata watch records 2 pressure event among 7 configured repositories. Limit: Repository metadata can show public pressure or disappearance but cannot establish the actor or motive behind a change. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/github-refuge-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 60% of the 10-app panel is unavailable in China's storefront
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current panel finds 60% of 10 tracked apps unavailable in the China storefront. Limit: A fixed app panel is transparent but not representative of the entire App Store catalogue. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/app-storefront-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 28.13% of 110,255 tested apps are unavailable in mainland China
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current AppleCensorship corpus reports 28.13% unavailable among 110,255 tested apps for mainland China. Limit: Storefront unavailability can have policy, licensing, commercial or technical causes; the percentage alone does not identify cause. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/apple-censorship-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 3 official money-market benchmark families are reporting
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current CFETS reading contains 3 reporting benchmark families. Limit: Official benchmark levels are state-published inputs; interpreting policy requires relationships and history, not one level. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/china-econ-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] The official yuan fix gap is -0.9013% against the independent reference
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current official-fix minus independent-reference gap is -0.9013%. Limit: The comparison is onshore and same-day but not simultaneous; it is economic context, not direct evidence of censorship. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/cny-fix-gap-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Southbound Stock Connect net flow is -7.63 billion Hong Kong dollars
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: HKEX reports current southbound Stock Connect net flow of -7.63 billion Hong Kong dollars. Limit: HKEX no longer publishes the northbound buy-sell split, so no northbound net flow is inferred. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/stock-connect-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] The official-data darkness index is 0.1889 across 7 watched series
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current publication-cadence darkness index is 0.1889 across 7 watched official series. Limit: Publication delay, calendar changes and collection failure can resemble withholding; per-series state is required for interpretation. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/data-darkness-latest.json

item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: No current finding is published for Believability read because the source status is degraded.
